findings.message: mcp_servers.docs.env.DOCS_TOKEN value "$not-a-name" looks like an environment reference but is not a valid one. Environment references must be $UPPER_SNAKE_CASE (e.g. $SLACK_BOT_TOKEN) — no lowercase, no leading digit, no ${...} braces. Fix the variable name, or remove the leading "$" if this is genuinely a literal value.
